data.description:
## Acceptance Criteria
- Unit tests verify concurrent prefills capped to `parallel` limit
- Tests confirm additional prefills are queued or fallback (not dispatched)
- Tests guard rejects dispatch when `local_prefill_in_flight >= parallel`
- Tests cover edge cases: guard boundary at exact parallel count, rapid guard enter/exit

## Key Files
- `proxy/tests/test_local_dispatch_gate.py`
data.title: Test: Prefill-aware dispatch guard unit tests
